title: Quantyra optical fixture system
description: Fixed light-source stands (34 mm preferred edge-alignment and 32 mm narrow option), dual V11 photodiode-jig cradle and independent lift-off hood. Editable OpenSCAD, exact supplied STLs, original machine-specific G-code and documentation under CERN-OHL-S-2.0. Packaging v1.0.0. Exact source slicing and physical commissioning are not established.
